jobs.occupation: Finance Manager Sweden & Norway | DOVISTA | Edsbyn
jobs.description:
Lead Finance across Sweden and Norway in a key leadership role within DOVISTA. As Finance Manager Sweden & Norway, you will combine people leadership, financial governance, and business impact while helping shape the future finance organisation in an international manufacturing group embarking on a major finance and ERP transformation journey.

Drive Financial Excellence Across Sweden and Norway
 As Finance Manager Sweden & Norway, you will be responsible for Finance Reporting & Compliance activities across DOVISTA Sverige AB and Natre Vinduer AS. Reporting to the Head of Accounting & Reporting Region North, you will lead and develop a team of eight finance professionals in Sweden, covering General Ledger, Accounts Payable, and Accounts Receivable, while collaborating closely with colleagues across Sweden, Norway, Denmark, and Group Finance.
You will ensure high-quality financial reporting, compliance, governance, and internal control across the region, while supporting budgeting, forecasting, and business performance follow-up. In addition, you will play an important role in driving process improvements, standardisation, and future ERP initiatives across the organisation.
What You'll Bring
We believe you are an experienced finance leader with a strong accounting foundation and a genuine interest in developing both people and processes. You enjoy working in a collaborative environment and can balance strategic thinking with hands-on involvement when needed.
To succeed in this role, you bring:
- A university degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
- Proven people leadership experience within finance, accounting, reporting, or controlling.
- Strong knowledge of financial reporting, accounting, compliance, audits, and internal controls.
- Experience from a manufacturing or industrial environment.
- Excellent communication skills in Swedish and English.
Experience from ERP implementations, finance transformation projects, or Norwegian accounting regulations is considered an advantage.
Why Join DOVISTA?
DOVISTA is one of Europe's leading providers of vertical windows and exterior doors, with approximately 7,000 employees across 10 markets. In Sweden, DOVISTA includes well-known brands such as Svenska Fönster, Mockfjärds, and VELFAC, while Natre is a leading window manufacturer in Norway.
In this role, you will:
- Lead a dedicated finance team.
- Influence the future development of the finance organisation.
- Drive improvement and transformation initiatives.
- Collaborate with stakeholders across the Nordic region.
- Make an impact in a business with approximately 950 employees and annual revenues of around SEK 2 billion.
The position is based in Edsbyn and offers a hybrid working model, with regular on-site presence supporting close collaboration, leadership, and team development. Limited travel within the Nordic region is required.

Due to GDPR regulations, we do not accept applications via email.
In this recruitment process, DOVISTA Sverige AB is collaborating with Jefferson Wells. You will be employed directly by DOVISTA Sverige AB.
Apply as soon as possible, but no later than December 18, 2026. Selection and interviews are conducted on an ongoing basis, and the position may be filled before the application deadline.

jobs.occupation: Accounts Payable Specialist wanted in Boden
jobs.description:
Are you a structured and detail-oriented Accounts Payable Specialist with a passion for order, structure, and efficiency? Do you have experience in accounts payable within production, warehouse, or logistics and thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment? Then this might be the right challenge for you!
About the position 
Perido is looking for an Accounts Payable Specialist on behalf of our client, an industrial enterprise driving large-scale initiatives within green energy and manufacturing. The position is located in Boden, with the possibility of working remotely two days a week.
Your daily tasks
In the role of AP Specialist, you will work in a fast-paced environment where you will be responsible for all parts of the accounts payable process with high accuracy and compliance.
These are the main focus tasks:
Manage and drive the accounts payable (AP) process with a focus on accuracy and adherence to internal controls
Work proactively to efficiently and accurately handle and correct historical transactions
Maintain order and structure in AP processes and ensure clear documentation
Adapt to a changing business environment and contribute with problem-solving skills and flexibility
Create stability, focus, and a calm, structured work atmosphere even under high pressure

Your characteristics
We are looking for someone who is highly structured, detail-oriented, and passionate about order and efficiency. You are a flexible thinker who understands the importance of correcting historical transactions and easily adapts to changing business needs. You thrive in a high-tempo, energetic environment where you maintain your focus and contribute calm and stability even in high-pressure situations.
Is this a challenge you would like to take on? We look forward to reading your application, welcome with your application today!
Qualifications:
Experience working with accounts payable within production, warehouse, or logistics
Fluent in English (written and spoken)

Meritorious:
Experience in SAP or Medius is highly advantageous

Full-time, consulting assignment until 2027-11-02. Start asap.

jobs.occupation: Electrical System Engineer –Extended scope and MGT oil&gas
jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day

Join our Electrical Engineering team and create detailed, customer-specific electrical designs for Medium Gas Turbine projects. You’ll work closely with project teams to deliver layouts, circuit diagrams, and documentation, ensuring every customer requirement is met. Support projects from design through assembly, collaborating with control, mechanical, and project lead teams. You’ll also interact with assembly, site teams, subcontractors, and purchasing, making a real impact in a growing market.
How You’ll Make an Impact
Deliver electrical designs and documentation, including layouts and circuit diagrams.
Collaborate with control, mechanical, and project lead teams to meet project goals.
Support assembly and site teams throughout the project lifecycle.
Work with subcontractors, purchasing, and sales to align on requirements.
Contribute to a culture of quality, improvement, and teamwork.

What You Bring
Degree in electrical engineering and several years of experience.
Proficiency with Eplan, AutoCAD, SPICE, and customer documentation.
Experience with power generation products; COMOS and SAP knowledge is a plus.
Strong English communication skills.
Team-oriented, driven, and focused on quality and customer satisfaction.

About the Team
You’ll be part of the electrical engineering team within Extended Scope and MGT Oil & Gas, working alongside teams in project engineering, technical and business, mechanical, and process. We handle all electrical installations, from high to low voltage, and value strong cooperation and a supportive, diverse environment.
Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.
We can offer you employment benefits such as: reduction of working hours, advance vacation, health care allowance and an eventual possibility to a flexible working place.
Who is Siemens Energy?
At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation. 
Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation. 
Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo
Our Commitment to Diversity
Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Join an exciting opportunity where you will have a key role in shaping and growing the company's e-commerce business!
About the position

This is an exciting opportunity for someone who wants to take ownership of the company's B2C e-commerce channels and drive online sales growth. In this role, you will play a key part in developing and managing e-commerce operations, implementing sales strategies, and ensuring a strong and efficient online business.
Your daily tasks
As an E-commerce Sales Manager, you will be responsible for establishing and managing the company's B2C e-commerce channels, coordinating daily operations, and driving business development.

At Proposales, we're transforming how hotels sell and manage Groups, Meetings & Events. We're building a modern product platform for an industry that still relies heavily on legacy systems and manual processes, helping hotels move from inquiry to booking and delivery through beautifully designed software, automation and AI. It all runs in one connected flow, where prices, taxes and payments have to add up.
We're now expanding beyond a proposal tool into a complete AI-powered platform for group sales and event management. As Full-Stack Engineer (Payments) you'll own the payment infrastructure across our different products. You'll join an experienced engineering team where good ideas win arguments. Expect us to challenge your designs, and expect to challenge ours. The role is based at our HQ in Stockholm, fully on-site.
Your mission:

Own our payment infrastructure from idea to launch: shape the scope with product and leadership, design it, build it and follow it into use.

Design and build our payment provider integrations, covering payments, refunds, webhooks, payouts and reconciliation.

Make architecture decisions for flows where a mistake costs a hotel real money, with idempotency, retries and clear audit trails built in from the start.

Work across the rest of the platform too, in a TypeScript codebase that handles real bookings for hotels in more than 40 countries.

Review your colleagues' code, and have yours reviewed.

Work with finance and customer success to understand how hotels actually get paid, and turn that into product decisions.

Ensure secure and compliant payment operations, including PCI DSS, KYC, and evolving regulatory requirements as we scale our payments offering.

A bit about you:

You have built and run payment systems in production, and you know what breaks in them.

Hands-on experience integrating payment providers. You can walk us through an integration you built and the decisions behind it.

You understand finance and fintech: how money moves, settlement, fees, currencies and reconciliation.

You review AI-generated code as carefully as your own.

You care that money is correct to the cent, and that code is still easy to change a year later.

Experience with several payment providers, or with hospitality tech, is a strong plus.

Fluent English, written and spoken.

You live in Stockholm, and want to work on-site with your team.

Some of the technologies you'll work with:

TypeScript, React, Next.js

Node.js, PostgreSQL

Payment provider integrations

Vercel, AWS

What we offer:

Real ownership. Payments is a growing part of Proposales, so you'll shape how it's built instead of inheriting someone else's design.

Problems worth solving. Many currencies, tax rules and hotel systems, all in one flow that has to add up.

A proven product. Proposales has been recognised as #1 in the Hotel Tech Awards for five consecutive years and is listed on the Deloitte Technology Fast 500 as one of the fastest-growing technology companies in the EMEA region.

Short decision lines. You'll work closely with leadership, and your ideas turn into action quickly.

Competitive salary that reflects your experience.

A personal development and wellbeing budget to invest in yourself.

A small, international, close-knit team in our Stockholm office, with an annual meetup and regular team activities.

How we work:
In payments, being correct matters more than being fast. Code goes through review, and the critical parts are covered by tests before anything reaches customers. We use AI agents every day: they speed up the work, but engineers own the design and the code. We're serverless first, hosted on Vercel.

About us
EcoPhi builds hardware for digital substations. Our two products are the CMPC800, a centralised substation server, and the QMU800, a modular merging unit. Utilities and system integrators use them to modernise the grid with IEC 61850-based protection, control and monitoring.
We are looking for an application engineer who will push our products to their limits in the lab, so they never fail in the field.
The role
You are responsible for our test lab. You build realistic substation setups, run the CMPC800 and QMU800 through normal operation, edge cases and failure scenarios, and find the problems before our customers do. Your findings go straight to R&D and inform the next release.
You also bring that knowledge to customers. You know how our products behave, so you help customers configure them, test them and put them into service.
What you will do
Lab and experimental setup
Build and maintain our test lab: test benches, network setups and reference substation configurations
Design experimental setups that simulate real substations, including third-party IEDs, switches, clocks and protection relays
Use hardware in the loop devices, such as Omicron or Typhoon-HIL, to inject currents and voltages and verify behaviour
Prepare demo and proof-of-concept setups for customers and exhibitions

Testing and stress testing
Write and run test plans for new hardware revisions and firmware releases
Stress test the products: high network load, many sampled value streams, GOOSE storms, loss of PTP time sync, redundancy failover (PRP/HSR), power cycling and long-duration runs
Run interoperability tests with other vendors' equipment
Prepare for and support type testing, certification and IEC 61850 conformance testing
Automate recurring tests where it makes sense

Analysis and feedback to R&D
Capture and analyse network traffic with tools such as Wireshark
Measure timing, latency, accuracy and synchronisation performance
Reproduce field issues in the lab and find the root cause together with R&D
Write clear test reports and bug reports

Customer support
Help customers and integrators configure our products, including SCL files, sampled values, GOOSE and time sync
Support factory acceptance tests (FAT), site acceptance tests (SAT) and commissioning when needed
Write application notes, configuration guides and test procedures

Who you are
Must have
Degree in electrical engineering, power engineering or a related field
EU citizenship or permanent residency
Practical knowledge of IEC 61850: SCL files, GOOSE and sampled values
Experience building lab setups and running structured tests
Comfortable with network analysis and Ethernet networking
Methodical, curious and good at documenting what you find
Fluent in English, written and spoken

Nice to have
Experience with testing, substation automation, or protection and control
Experience with relay test sets, such as Omicron CMC or Doble
Knowledge of PTP time sync (IEEE 1588, IEC 61850-9-3) and PRP/HSR redundancy
Experience with type testing, EMC or environmental testing
Experience from a utility, system integrator or substation equipment vendor

What we offer
Ownership of our test lab and a direct impact on product quality
Close collaboration with R&D and a direct line to the founders
Hands-on work with the latest digital substation technology
Benefits: Occupational pension (ITP) and a generous wellness allowance (friskvårdsbidrag)
Location: Primarily in our Gothenburg office, with flexibility on partial remote work

How to apply
Include your CV and a short note on why this role fits you. If you have any questions, reach out to jakob@ecophi.ai.

About us
EcoPhi builds hardware for digital substations. Our two products are the CMPC800, a centralised substation server, and the QMU800, a modular merging unit. Utilities and system integrators use them to modernise the grid with IEC 61850-based protection, control and monitoring.
We are looking for a product manager who will own the CMPC800 and QMU800 end to end: what we build, who we sell it to, and how it reaches the customer.
The role
You are the voice of the customer inside the company and the owner of our product line. You decide, together with the founders and engineering, what goes into the next release and why. You know what utilities ask for in their tenders, where competitors are ahead or behind, and the you guide the direction of our products.
We are a small company, so you will be involved in the real product chain as well. You will draft quotes, follow up with our production partners and make sure customers get what they ordered. That is how you stay close to the customer and the product.
What you will do
Product strategy and roadmap
Own the product roadmap for the CMPC800 and QMU800
Collect customer feedback, feature requests and lost-tender reasons, and turn them into clear priorities
Write product requirements and work with hardware and firmware engineers to deliver them
Decide on product variants, options and new I/O modules based on market demand
Plan firmware releases and communicate what is in them

Market and competition
Follow what utilities, TSOs and DSOs ask for in their digital substation specifications
Track competitors and position our products against them
Identify new markets, customer segments and partnerships with system integrators
Follow standards development, such as IEC 61850, IEC 61869-9 and cybersecurity requirements

Pricing, sales and customer support
Own pricing and price lists together with the founders
Respond to RFIs, RFQs and tenders, and draft quotations
Fill in tender compliance matrices with support from engineering
Present our products to customers and join technical meetings
Maintain datasheets, product presentations and other sales material

Product lifecycle and operations
Plan type testing, certification and utility qualification
Manage component obsolescence and product lifecycle together with engineering

About the role
You will join a large ophthalmology department with more than 250 professionals, covering outpatient care, emergency eye services, inpatient wards, and surgical units. The pediatric ophthalmology section provides comprehensive diagnostic and therapeutic care for children and collaborates closely with electrophysiology and hereditary disease units.
You will work in multidisciplinary teams that include physicians, orthoptists, nurses, optometrists, and technicians, all focused on delivering patient-centered, high-quality eye care. As part of a university hospital, you will also have the opportunity to participate in teaching, clinical research, and innovation projects.
Requirements
EU-recognized specialist certification in ophthalmology
Minimum five years of clinical experience in ophthalmology
Focus and competence in pediatric ophthalmology
Strong interest in teaching, research, and clinical development
Good communication skills in English and willingness to learn Swedish
Team-oriented, responsible, and committed to providing high-quality patient care
Experience or competence in medical retina is considered an advantage

Language and relocation support
A willingness and motivation to learn Swedish is important for your integration and clinical work.
The relocation process begins once you reach language level B2. During this stage, you will work 50% clinically and study 50% Swedish until you achieve C1 level, which is required to apply for a Swedish specialist license (specialistbevis) to practice as a specialist doctor.
Language training is provided free of charge once you have accepted an employment offer.
You will receive full support throughout the licensing and relocation process, including assistance with documentation, Swedish authorization, and settling in Sweden.

What Dignus Medical offers you
Ongoing support from a recruiter before, during, and after your employment
Assistance with obtaining Swedish authorization and specialist approvals, if required
Help with accommodation and relocation, including support for your family
Access to a free language course with a private tutor via Teams/Skype
